components.name: Primary Ink Button
components.description: Primary pill action button with Cobalt hover shift and spring press.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #0E1116; color: #F7F7F4; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 108%; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #1F4FE0; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio treats a project manager's career as a high-capacity transit network. Every section is a station on one of six colour-coded lines (L1 Cobalt through L6 Magenta), connected by a continuous vertical route rail along the left margin that fills with colour as the visitor travels down the page. It rejects the SaaS template of gradient text, glassmorphism, and uniform dark cards in favour of flat poster ink, warm off-white stock, octilinear 45-degree schematic diagrams, station roundels, and split-flap departure boards.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous scroll-linked vertical route rail with circular station roundels (L1–L6, INFO, END).
Six flat, saturated transit line colours; zero decorative gradients or glass blur.
Variable-width Archivo typography pairing expanded black (125% stretch, 850 weight) headlines with normal-width body copy.
Departure-board strips (#0E1116 background, #FFCB3D tabular uppercase text) for verified portfolio metrics.

rules.name: The Flat Pigment Rule
rules.body: Line colours are always flat, opaque pigments. Never blend two line colours in a gradient or apply glowing neon drop shadows.

rules.name: The Drench Commitment Rule
rules.body: When a section or outcome card is drenched (Vermilion Express, Central Terminus, Case Outcome), the colour owns the entire region edge-to-edge.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry an eyebrow or kicker label above them. The station roundel sits on the left rail and the route badge sits inline beside the heading.

rules.name: The Rule-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards use a 1.5px rule border at rest and never combine a resting drop shadow with a border.

dos: Do assign every section, project sector, and skill zone to one of the six canonical line colours.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (.tabular) on all metrics, years, counts, and station codes.
Do gate hover transforms behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and honour prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't place an eyebrow or kicker label above <h1> or <h2> headings.
Don't use CSS gradients on text, backgrounds, or buttons, or backdrop-filter: blur() glass effects.
Don't use thick coloured border-left callout stripes on cards or notes; use a circular .station dot marker instead.
